notes: E1 and M1 runtimes create isolated in-memory runs from their approved seed entries; each run receives a new unique run_id.
The M1 historical coupon is valid at the seed clock instant. Its exact expiry is unspecified; after clock advancement, expiry status is not evaluated.

S1 has a first local runtime slice. One purchase path, per-user limit, idempotent replay, and a single-operation stock ledger observation are covered; R02 remains partial because exhaustion and concurrency were not tested.
S1 queue semantics, eventual-consistency SLA, cancellation/timeout release timing, and load testing remain outside this demo scope.
All users are synthetic. No real accounts, payments or shipments.
